decision_rules.fail_veto_zh: 任一必要群体在普通服务、可达性、安全、费用、等待、申诉、数据权利、人工接管或退出恢复任一适用项为FAIL，该场景不得总体通过、扩大或复制。
decision_rules.fail_veto_en: If any necessary group receives FAIL on any applicable ordinary-service, accessibility, safety, cost, wait, appeal, data-rights, human-takeover, or exit-restoration item, the scenario may not pass overall, expand, or replicate.
decision_rules.unknown_rule_zh: UNKNOWN表示尚无充分现场证据，不得计为通过、零事件、无差异或未受影响，也不得由其他群体或平均值抵消。
decision_rules.unknown_rule_en: UNKNOWN means field evidence is insufficient. It may not be counted as pass, zero events, no difference, or no impact, and may not be offset by another group or an average.
decision_rules.overall_pass_rule_zh: 只有所有必要群体的全部适用项均为PASS，且普通基线、人工接管、失电/断网与解编恢复形成依法签收的现场记录，场景才可由有权角色另行评为PASS。
decision_rules.overall_pass_rule_en: A scenario may be separately rated PASS by authorised roles only when every applicable item for every necessary group is PASS and lawfully received field records cover the ordinary baseline, human takeover, power/network loss, and unweaving restoration.
decision_rules.no_aggregation_rule_zh: 不以总体平均、访问量、注册量、签约量或单一成功案例替代逐群体判断。
decision_rules.no_aggregation_rule_en: No overall average, visit count, registration count, contract count, or single success case may replace group-by-group judgement.

scenario_english_equivalents.mapping_rule_en: Each key maps to the scenario with the same scenario_id; these fields are faithful English equivalents of the corresponding *_zh fields in scenario_register and do not add field evidence.

ordinary_baseline.no_penalty_rule: Not using the automated evaluation tool does not affect the right to request human validation.

proposed_functions: AI enters only an isolated test unit and is not connected directly to real urban services.
Test outputs enter the public validation corridor through a read-only interface.
ai_increment.decision_boundary: Independent reproduction records and reasoned pass, restricted-use, remediation, or stop opinions

power_loss_and_unweaving.immediate_action: Stop testing and freeze the conclusion.
power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Checklist for access revocation, data clearing, and equipment return

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: To be set by a future authorised agreement; no long-term retention may be promised before then.

ordinary_baseline.no_penalty_rule: Equivalent basic service remains available when the network is down or on-device AI is refused.
ordinary_baseline.evidence_required: Exercise of the equivalent offline route

proposed_functions: The on-device model performs only limited recognition or prompting tasks.
Minimal energy and fault summaries enter the validation node.

stop_triggers: The device was updated without retesting
power_loss_and_unweaving.immediate_action: Switch to fixed rules or staffed service and isolate the device.
power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Receipt for device disconnection, service restoration, and log archiving

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: At least through the pilot and exit-review period; the exact term remains subject to authorisation.

channels: Ordinary route with no added detour
ordinary_baseline.no_penalty_rule: People who do not participate incur no detour, waiting, or data-collection burden.
ordinary_baseline.evidence_required: Prior on-site passage and accessibility record

ai_increment.decision_boundary: Safety-officer event records and independent incident review

stop_triggers: The enclosure or ordinary route fails
power_loss_and_unweaving.immediate_action: Stop and isolate the device, then restore ordinary public space.
power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Receipt for equipment removal, site restoration, and incident handling

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: If lawfully admitted to controlled validation, maintain until exit acceptance is complete; no continuing-maintenance commitment arises before validation begins.

ordinary_baseline.no_penalty_rule: Not using a digital channel does not reduce intake priority or remedy rights.

proposed_functions: AI only assists event classification and material retrieval.

ai_increment.decision_boundary: Itemised handling, objection, and restoration-review records

stop_triggers: Data and space restoration cannot be completed
power_loss_and_unweaving.immediate_action: Pause the relevant scenario and transfer it to dedicated human handling.
power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Five-part closure record for notice, data, contract, equipment, and site

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: Update before each launch and archive after exit for the authorised term.

ordinary_baseline.evidence_required: Comparison of staffed-service and digital-service paths

power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Record of account revocation, personal-data disposition, and service restoration

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: Update by course cycle and clearly withdraw expired content.

proposed_functions: AI generates explainable alternative routes only from inspected information.

power_loss_and_unweaving.immediate_action: Withdraw dynamic advice and restore fixed wayfinding and staffed service.

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: If lawfully incorporated into ordinary public information service, maintain under later-defined operating responsibility and term; no continuing service is promised before then.

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: If lawfully incorporated into formal service, update under a later-defined service cycle and operating responsibility; no continuing service is promised before then.

stop_triggers: Confidential or personal-data boundary is crossed

power_loss_and_unweaving.required_restoration_receipt: Record of data isolation, access revocation, and consultation correction

non_ai_survival_after_exit.retention_boundary: Update through review against current rules.

ordinary_baseline.no_penalty_rule: Teams not using automated matching have equal access to information and submission.

authority_boundary_zh: 本登记表是十二类场景的公共价值预登记模板。全部条目为proposed_unverified，现场测试未获授权、未运行，绩效为空；不得解释为已有公共收益、群体同意、服务等价、无障碍达标、运营承诺或实施批准。
authority_boundary_en: This register is a public-value preregistration template for twelve scenarios. Every item is proposed_unverified; field testing is unauthorised and not run, and performance is null. Nothing here demonstrates existing public benefit, group consent, service equivalence, accessibility compliance, an operating commitment, or implementation approval.
